_about: 0.3.0 (5 Nov 2026, Unreleased), GitHub issue 21 and the owner's rules: danger alerts beside the ring in a stack per side, the glow's off switch named on the Shield hit cue row.

shield_cue.help: A screen-edge cue made of your shield's own hit effect when it is hit, and a flash when it fails. Also switches the glow and pulse of HUD 2's danger alerts.
